meta.description:
A new planet marked by is ancient civilizations and wars during is history, named [accent[]]Clasmodila[[]].
The [accent[]]Sharded[[]] team has sent you here to retrieve information about this planet, yet you know theres more than just information.

Adds a new storyline to the game where you are selected as the leader of an operation to retake control on [accent[]]Clasmodila[[]] after a new enemy, [accent[]]Anthalos[[]], decided to show up and settle their own regiment.
[red[]]NOTE: THIS IS A HARD MOD[[]]
